subject: Delegated subprocessor responsibilities + evidence logistics
messages:
From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@novamed.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>; security@novamed.com
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: delegated subprocessor responsibilities + SIG evidence

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of our vendor intake we need two items to proceed with procurement: a csv listing all third-party subprocessors that will process Novamed data (including jurisdiction and purpose), and a short statement identifying which subprocessors we should consider 'delegated' for encryption/key custody or SOC2-scope access.

We also need a consolidated SIG evidence bundle for those delegated subprocessors, ideally containing CAIQ/SIG references, attestations (SOC2 or ISO where available), and any KMS ownership mappings. Can you confirm you can provide these artifacts by EOD Monday (May 25)? If not, please propose a timeline and any blockers.

Appreciate it,

Carlos Vega
Senior Security Manager | Novamed Health
Carlos.Vega@novamed.com


From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: delegated subprocessor responsibilities + SIG evidence

Carlos — thanks for the clear ask. We can take this on. High-level plan: (1) export our canonical subprocessor roster with jurisdiction & purpose, (2) mark delegated subprocessors per our KMS/privilege model, (3) compile SIG/CAIQ artifacts and available attestations.

Marissa and Jonas, looping you both to validate the roster and assemble the evidence bundle. Marissa — can you export the latest roster and PSR mappings? Jonas — can you prepare the KMS ownership matrix and point me to any attestation PDFs we have for onshore providers?

Carlos — we aim to deliver an initial package by Monday EOD, and if anything slows us we'll send an interim CSV + timeline. If Novamed has a preferred manifest format, share it and we'll adapt.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Head, Vendor Risk & Compliance | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: delegated subprocessor responsibilities + SIG evidence

Mina / Jonas — I exported the roster and started a minimal CSV with the columns Novamed requested: vendor_name, vendor_email, service_purpose, processing_region, data_classes, regulatory_notes. Attachment: redwood_subprocessor_roster_2026.csv (csv stub).

Notes from the export:
- We have 18 subprocessors flagged for production inference pipelines; 3 are for telemetry/monitoring only.
- Jurisdictions: primarily US and EU; one provider (EdgeAccel) is in APAC (Singapore) and has a separate data-residency contract.
- Delegated-for-keys candidates: StorageLayer Inc., KeyVault Partners, and OnPremOps (only for private deployments).

Jonas — can you confirm the KMS mappings and whether StorageLayer has an active SOC2 report we can include? If not, we'll flag as 'attestation pending' in the manifest.

Marissa
Product Security Analyst | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@novamed.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: delegated subprocessor responsibilities + SIG evidence

Carlos — attaching the initial package for Novamed (see Drive link below). Highlights:

- redwood_subprocessor_roster_2026.csv — roster with jurisdiction + purpose + data classes.
- kms_escrow_matrix.pdf — shows which providers hold encryption keys or have access to KMS (StorageLayer Inc. and KeyVault Partners are delegated for multi-tenant key wrapping; OnPremOps is delegated only under private deployments).
- sig_evidence_bundle.zip — consolidated SIG/CAIQ references: we included available SOC2 PDFs, CAIQ exported answers for our core platform, and a short readme explaining gaps.

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-subproc-roster

A couple of caveats: StorageLayer's latest SOC2 is in review and we only have the bridge letter; we flagged that in the csv with an action item to collect the full report. EdgeAccel's data-residency agreement is included for your review.

If Novamed needs notarized attestations or a channel to request a direct SOC2 transfer, let us know and we can coordinate with our provider contacts and DocuSign flow (reference DOCUSIGN-REQ-4491).

Best regards,

Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
